title: Capture
description: Slice 4A/4A.1/4B2 strict capture fact: one logical photo occurrence with frozen visual_context, immutable capture_kind/subject_refs, and required per-capture capture_decision_evidence (TAKE only). Not Camera Roll media. Pre-life contract completion; schema_version remains 1.

occurrence_key.description: Must equal stable_id("capture-occurrence", activity_instance_id, opportunity_key). Not array index, UUID, or timestamp-only.

captured_at.description: Authoritative capture time; canonical Asia/Tokyo second precision.

capture_kind.description: Factual subject/framing class only. Not quality, attractiveness, post-worthiness, or SNS intent.

subject_refs.description: Semantically unordered explicit subject identity refs; Capture-local canonical string sort. Empty allowed except PEOPLE (non-empty) and SELFIE (must include character_id).

capture_context_hash.description: canonical_hash(normalized visual_context) only; does not include capture_kind/subject_refs/evidence. 64 lower-case hex

capture_decision_evidence.description: Per-capture TAKE evidence; included in full Capture semantic equality. Not copied to CameraRollRecord.

visual_context.description: Frozen capture-time visual context. No prompt/provider/seed/file/post fields.

outfit_item_ids.description: Semantically unordered; canonicalized by string sort for hash/persist

companion_refs.description: Semantically unordered; canonicalized by string sort for hash/persist
